svg.aria-label: Arrow F.C.. The official website of Arrow F.C., an eight-a-side football team in Piedmont. Squad, fixtures with scorers, honours, gallery and sponsors. A 3-3-1 line-up that rotates on its own, a FIFA-style "open a pack" animation, and an admin panel (Supabase) where matches, players and sponsors are managed and statistics are calculated automatically.
